text_block_list.text:
One night, just before the 'Wasurenagusa 
Sho' and the 'Oka Sho' were about to take 
place—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—S-So the phlegmon has completely healed 
then...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yep♡ The teacher officially gave me their 
stamp of approval today♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we made it in time~! 
Chrono-chan, thank you so much for all 
your help up until now!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all... I believe it is the 
fruit of Love-chan's own efforts... She 
endured the pain and persevered the entire 
time.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"With this... we can go to Hanshin 
Racecourse together."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right. I'm running the Wasurenagusa Sho, 
and Chrono-chan is in the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's both put on our best, most lovely 
run so we can achieve great results!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Let's make this year's Tiara 
route... a generation etched into racing 
history together.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's super lovely!
The day of the 'Wasurenagusa Sho'.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—This year, that Junior Class Queen girl 
has gotta be the top contender, right?! 
She was amazing in the Tulip Sho too...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I dunno about that. Personally, I think 
Gran Alegria is pretty incredible too. 
Winning her first graded stakes like that 
is seriously impressive.

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"As expected, everyone's only talking 
about the main race~ Still, if Loves-chan 
wins today and carries that to the Oaks, 
I'm sure...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —...Mm-hmm♪ Feeling in top shape...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, I'm ready whenever you 
are...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, I'm ready whenever you 
are...!

Loves Only You arrived at the Wasurenagusa 
Sho in peak condition. Her focus today 
seems absolutely flawless as well...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Thank you once again, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Thank you once again, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Because you believed in me, I am able to 
run in this race today—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Because you believed in me, I'm able to 
run in this race today—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Watch me from up close, okay?♪ See my 
running that answers your trust!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Watch me from up close, okay?♪ See my 
running that answers your trust!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it...!

text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You's spring was about to 
begin...!
